surface: local loopback HTTP, ports 8798-8799, local Ollama qwen3.6 planner

checks.note: The stop arrived while the turn was planning; the running turn then returned status cancelled at the planned checkpoint and discarded all partial work.
A stop that arrives after the turn finished says so instead of claiming a cancel.
The second question waited about 7 seconds in the bounded queue and answered; it was not rejected instantly.

limitations: Cancellation is checked at stage boundaries; an Ollama inference already in flight completes before the stop takes effect.
The live run was two journeys, not a load or capacity test.
Queue capacity is three waiting turns; a fourth and a wait past 45 seconds are refused, and that refusal was not produced live, only in component tests.
